proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_root + MagicItemRecord kind
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord are the only options. magic_item_root already exists in the v4 atom inventory but there is no corresponding surface type family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Rare — brazier is a magic item, not a spell, class feature, or mastery.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: dawn
proposed_widenings.justification: The brazier recharges at dawn, not on a short or long rest. No dawn cadence exists in RestResetCadence.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: magic_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation cost is a Magic action. ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports free and bonus_action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental

proposed_widenings.name: create_companion + command_companion subgraph for magic items
proposed_widenings.justification: The core mechanic is summoning a creature (Fire Elemental) that obeys the user. create_companion and command_companion are v4 atoms but nothing in the surface types encodes a summoning effect family for magic items.
proposed_widenings.evidence: summon a Fire Elemental ... obeys your commands

proposed_widenings.name: Companion duration: timed with dismiss option
proposed_widenings.justification: The elemental persists 1 hour, dies, or is dismissed as a Bonus Action. Dismissal-as-bonus-action is a new duration termination shape not present on any existing Duration variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: Proximity constraint on activation
proposed_widenings.justification: Activation requires the user to be within 5 feet of the brazier. No proximity-to-item constraint exists in any activation cost or precondition shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action

proposed_widenings.name: Initiative placement for summoned companion
proposed_widenings.justification: The companion takes its turn immediately after the user on their Initiative count. No initiative-placement shape exists for summoned creatures.
proposed_widenings.evidence: takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count

notes: The primary blocker is the complete absence of a magic_item UnitRecord kind. magic_item_root is in the v4 taxonomy but the surface has no corresponding type family. All secondary gaps (dawn reset, magic-action cost, create_companion subgraph, initiative placement, proximity constraint) are real but moot until the kind is added.
